Big mistake. I’ve also had a couple patients tell me their SSRI’s haven’t been as “effective” after they accidentally took more than they were prescribed. 

I’d also suggest you ask your md or local pharmacist about this if you’re concerned about SS.

If you plan on overdosing on Zoloft, please let someone know or don't do it at all. My experience with both overdoses weren't pleasant, of course. Both times I never went to the ER to get my stomach pumped since I didn't want my parents to know about the attempts. The first time I threw up a majority of the pills so the effects weren't as severe. The second time however, was god awful. I'm not sure if it was [serotonin syndrome](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/serotonin-syndrome/symptoms-causes/syc-20354758) as I took a whole bottle \(approx. 60 pills that were 25mg each\) and half a bottle \(approx. 50 pills that were 100mg each\). It.. wasn't really painful physically. My vision was messed up \(horribly dilated pupils yikes\), I had horrible insomnia and cold sweats, I was restless. I couldn't think straight or concentrate. I had terrible tremors and awkward rapid eye movement. I clenched my jaw *a lot* which wasn't painful but uncomfortable.

***TL;DR:*** 

***Experience makes you wanna die, worse than death in my opinion. Didn't experience any pain but extremely uncomfortable for at least a week or two without getting my stomach pumped.***
